localTips.title: Claim your 50% transit refund
localTips.why: Employers must reimburse half of your public-transport pass (prime transport). Some people never claim it.
tips: Send your Navigo or local pass receipt to HR or payroll.
Choose the yearly pass (Navigo Annuel) if you use it every month.
Ask about the forfait mobilités durables if you cycle or carpool.

pct.note: Estimate: only applies to people not already claiming the 50% refund

localTips.title: Compare offers to the regulated tariff
localTips.why: Many market offers are cheaper than the tarif réglementé (TRV), and the off-peak option can lower bills if you run appliances at night.
tips: Compare offers on energie-info.fr, the national energy ombudsman’s comparison site.
Check that your meter power (kVA) is not higher than you need.
Ask whether you are eligible for the chèque énergie.

pct.note: Estimate; market offers typically sit a few % to ~15% below the TRV

localTips.title: Switch insurer at any time after one year
localTips.why: Under the loi Hamon you can cancel home and car insurance at any time after the first year, and the new insurer handles it.
tips: Get 3 quotes for the same cover and excess.
Let the new insurer cancel the old contract for you.
Combine home and car with one insurer for a discount.

pct.note: Same as the general insurance re-quote rule; not a French statistic
